collection.title: VW Jetta 2011 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Jetta 2011 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: VW Jetta 2011 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
